title: Typesafe Semio Js Stores
description: Implement typesafe semio/js stores: typed KitEvent wire, GraphQL/schema tests, per-event subscriptions, remove command leaks from public API, migrate semio/react and semio/sketchpad off kitWire/executeSemioKitCommand.
summary: GraphQL: KitStoreBatchResult now exposes KitChangeSemanticKind enum + changeKindOther; authorsShallow is [AuthorShallowRow!]! (removed AuthorShallowList scalar). Rust kit_graphql implements AuthorShallowRow + semantic kind split. JS: KitChangeSemanticKindGql, kitChangeSemanticKindToWire, KitStoreBatchResultRow typed inverse as ChangeKitCommandWire[], batch mutation requests changeKindOther, changeKitWithInverse returns KitChangeKindWire + typed inverse. React: KitHostGraphOp uses Type/Design/Piece/Connection DTO ids and Plain/Diff types; added kitHostUndo/kitHostRedo; sketchpad undo/redo uses them. Regenerated semio/graphql/schema.graphql. Tests: cargo test --lib, nx build semio/graphql, @semio/js build+vitest (+new semantic kind test), @semio/react build+vitest.
